VI.description: RemoteVI Server\3A share any window in a web browser without writing code. Left\3A the windows that can be shared\2C LabVIEW's own first\2C then LabVIEW-built applications\2C then other programs (LabVIEW windows only narrows the list\3B it refreshes every 3 s and on Refresh list). Select one\2C choose the port\2C Whole network (default\3A this computer only) and View only\2C and press Share selected window. Right\3A the shares of this application instance with their port\2C reach and clients\2C live\3B select one for its details\2C Stop sharing\2C Copy link or Open in browser. Every link carries its share's random access token (docs\5Csecurity.md). A running VI of this LabVIEW is shared as a VI target\2C any other window as a window target (RemoteVI Server Share.vi). In LabVIEW (Tools menu) closing the window keeps the shares running\3B RemoteVI Server.exe stops every share when its window closes\2C runs a landing page listing the shares (default port 8088\2C the next free port when that is in use) and reads its command line (RemoteVI Parse Arguments.vi\3A --share <window title> --port N --token T --whole-network --view-only --landing-port P).
